issues.description: The script requests GM_xmlhttpRequest and @connect permission for translate.googleapis.com, but no actual GM_xmlhttpRequest usage is present in the provided code. This may be over-privileged.
issues.recommendation: Remove unused GM_xmlhttpRequest grant and @connect if not used.

issues.description: The script overrides window.fetch and XMLHttpRequest.prototype.open to block requests to 'neo.character.ai/feature_limits'. This is a form of request interception but does not transmit data to third parties.
issues.recommendation: Ensure no sensitive data is leaked in custom fetch/XHR handlers.

issues.description: The script uses localStorage to store feature toggles (e.g., 'cai_adv_fake_verify', 'cai_bypass_limit').
issues.recommendation: No sensitive user data is stored; usage is acceptable.

issues.description: The script uses GM_addStyle to inject CSS and manipulates the DOM to add UI elements. No evidence of DOM XSS or injection of untrusted content.
issues.recommendation: Continue to avoid inserting untrusted user input into innerHTML.

issues.description: The script uses @require to load turndown from unpkg.com, a reputable CDN, and pins the version to 7.1.3.
